unsupported_claims.quote: The exact timeline for the CA bundle from Northwind is uncertain (early next week).
unsupported_claims.reason: 'Early next week' was Northwind's reply on 2026-09-05; the 2026-09-11 update states Northwind has not replied at all, so presenting 'early next week' as the current timeline is outdated and contradicted by the latest ticket information.
